description: Restart docker compose services (docker compose -f <file> restart [service ...]), for example so they pick up a newly deployed certificate. With no services, the whole stack is restarted. Set test to true to check that the restart would work, changing nothing (uses docker compose --dry-run).

test.description: Check docker access, the compose file and the services, and run the restart with --dry-run. Restarts nothing.

compose_file.description: Absolute path of the compose file. A stack split over several files is given as one value joined with ':' (as in COMPOSE_FILE); each is passed with its own -f, in order.

services.description: Service names to restart. Omit to restart the whole stack.
